subject.title: fix(browser): use public ssrf runtime import in CDP proxy bypass

question: Should `registerManagedProxyBrowserCdpBypass` remain on the private owner-scoped `ssrf-runtime-internal` surface for Browser, or should maintainers promote it into the public `ssrf-runtime` Plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The one-line import cannot work against current exports, and the obvious way to make it work would change the SSRF/managed-proxy SDK security boundary rather than only fixing a browser import typo.

options.title: Preserve owner-scoped helper access
options.body: Keep the bypass helper private and repair packaged Browser resolution through the existing owner-scoped alias, staging, or another narrow private seam.

options.title: Approve public SDK promotion
options.body: Promote the helper only with explicit SDK/security approval, docs/API metadata, contract guardrails, and release-note context.

options.title: Choose a canonical sibling or replacement
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers pick one of the broader sibling PRs or a new replacement branch as the canonical repair for the linked regression.

recommendation.title: Preserve owner-scoped helper access
recommendation.body: Keep the bypass helper private and repair packaged Browser resolution through the existing owner-scoped alias, staging, or another narrow private seam.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about package/private SDK boundary hardening, an area connected to this person's recent and historical commits.
